feeds.title: Off the Eaten Path Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Off the Eaten Path! I'm Chrissie, a public defender by day and a blogger by night. I started Off the Eaten Path six months after I moved to Charlotte because I wanted to get out and explore my new city. What's a better way to explore a city through its local food and drink right?

feeds.title: There's Sugar In My Tea! » Cooking
feeds.description: There's Sugar In My Tea is a Southern Lifestyle Blog based in Charlotte, NC which provides women with tips to lead a more intentional, organized and productive life. Explore cooking tips, recipes, meal prep and planning and more!

feeds.title: Unpretentious Palate
feeds.description: Explore Charlotte restaurant reviews, food news, restaurant openings, and food events in Charlotte. Welcome to Unpretentious Palate, a digital publication covering food and drink based in Charlotte, North Carolina.

feeds.title: Heidi Billotto Food
feeds.description: Browse around for seasonal recipes, and info on my cooking classes and take your time to read more about local food, chefs, restaurants and food-centric travel. Heidi Billotto is a Charlotte Culinary Expert, FoodStylist and Caterer who writes about restaurants and food.

feeds.title: QC Exclusive » Food And Drink
feeds.description: See where to eat and what to order, taste our favorite cocktails, and meet the best chefs in Charlotte NC. From our start in 2011 to the present our team at QC Exclusive Magazine constantly strives to deliver Charlotte's best content, from creative writing to stunning photography.

feeds.title: Slice of Jess
feeds.description: Hey there, Jess here. Welcome to a slice of my kitchen! Here you'll find tidbits of my everyday life, home-cooked meals, and travel guides. I'm a self-taught chef who's cooking & eating her way through the Queen City of Charlotte, North Carolina.

feeds.title: Feast + West
feeds.description: Feast + West is Susannah's blog where she writes about her cooking adventures. Here you'll find recipes, travel guides, and tips for cooking and entertaining to help you indulge in your life, too. Susannah Brinkley Henry is a graphic designer and a food & travel blogger based in Charlotte, N.C.

feeds.title: Peanut Blossom
feeds.description: My name is Tiffany and I've spent the last 12 years sharing simple seasonal recipes for busy families that want to make mealtime a little more fun. You'll find plenty of inspiration for any meal or occasion with hundreds of kid-tested recipes and easy tips for making every celebration special.

feeds.title: Shay Jackson
feeds.description: My name is Shay Jackson. I love cooking, writing, creating DIY crafts, and taking photos. I'm a Food & Lifestyle blogger with a Graphic Design background. Currently eating and cooking in Charlotte, NC. My blog focuses on the fun that comes with cooking at home, dining out, easy crafts, and more.
